content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the presence of stale data in the TCS (Traffic Control System) blocks when the `rpmh_flush()` function was called. This stale data could trigger unintended behavior by executing old commands alongside newly flushed data. The patch addresses this by ensuring that the SLEEP and WAKE TCSes are invalidated before flushing new data, thus preventing any old data from interfering with the current operations.
